description:
Spacious apartment in a new building, an expansive kitchen with an induction stove, a bathroom with a separated toilet, and even a washroom, all for just... 4800 yen a month?! But there is a spooky reason Maison Shiba is so doggone affordable...

The room high schooler Kori Momose was offered came with a room mate: Mu-chan, a Shiba Inu who happens to be an earthbound spirit. With the ultimate goal of a comfortable lifestyle with no roommates, Kori tries all kinds of strategies to unbind Mu from room 101.

Get ready for a heartwarming comedy at Maison Shiba,full of quirky neighbors, adorable Shiba inus, and plenty of fluffy, chaotic fun!

(Source: SHIBA INU ROOMS Official Site)
